mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.* FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.role_id = ur.role_id INNER JOIN sys_menu m ON m.id = rm.menu_id AND m.deleted = 0 WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = 1 ORDER BY m.sort_no, m.id

SELECT DISTINCT m.* FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.role_id = ur.role_id AND rm.client_type IN ('BOTH', #{clientType}) INNER JOIN sys_menu m ON m.id = rm.menu_id AND m.deleted = 0 WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = 1 ORDER BY m.sort_no, m.id
SELECT m.*, rm.client_type AS client_type FROM sys_role_menu rm INNER JOIN sys_menu m ON m.id = rm.menu_id AND m.deleted = 0 WHERE rm.role_id = #{roleId} AND m.status = 1 ORDER BY m.sort_no, m.id

SELECT DISTINCT m.* FROM sys_role_menu rm INNER JOIN sys_menu m ON m.id = rm.menu_id AND m.deleted = 0 WHERE rm.role_id = #{roleId} AND rm.client_type IN ('BOTH', #{clientType}) AND m.status = 1 ORDER BY m.sort_no, m.id
